title: Block Out Level 18 Walkthrough
summary: Block Out Level 18 is a double-frame puzzle around a cyan `14/11` pair. Peel the side ladders and counters first, keep the center blocks together until the rails are thinner, and finish through the green top route.

variants.gameVersion: current iOS and Android catalog checked 2026-08-03

boardProfile.layout: Block Out Level 18 is a double-frame puzzle around a cyan `14/11` pair. Peel the side ladders and counters first, keep the center blocks together until the rails are thinner, and finish through the green top route.
landmarks: Block Out Level 18 is a double-frame puzzle around a cyan `14/11` pair.
Peel the side ladders and counters first, keep the center blocks together until the rails are thinner, and finish through the green top route.
The board mixes Cyan, Pink, Blue and more.
The opening layout is a color-sort grid.
Clear matched tiles to finish the level.

quickTips: Open the rails before you split the center pair.
The green top finish is a late route, not the first route.
Think in chain clears. The best move is the one that sets up the next two moves, not just the quickest current match.

steps.title: Move 1
steps.instruction: Strip the right white-and-black ladder so the side counters begin falling.

steps.title: Move 2
steps.instruction: Leave the cyan `14` cap and the cyan `11` centerpiece parked while the frame around them loosens.

steps.title: Move 3
steps.instruction: Mirror that cleanup on the left side once the first ladder has opened enough room.

steps.title: Move 4
steps.instruction: Separate the cyan `14` cap from the `11` block only after both side rails have narrowed.

steps.title: Move 5
steps.instruction: Use the freed top lane to peel away the blue and pink columns.

steps.title: Move 6
steps.instruction: Move the `11` block after the outer rails are already thin.

steps.title: Move 7
steps.instruction: Finish with the green top route and the last side leftovers.

failurePoints: Trying to split the `14/11` pair before the rails are open.
Using the top pink columns as early movers instead of late cleanup.
